rule: S199 (P-12/P-17) — the offline fixture Reality Check (a zero-data user's first screen) has NO bare verdict word: every UNJUDGEABLE/UNVERIFIED/INSUFFICIENT in the visible text carries BOTH a why and a path-to-judgeable (Unjudgeable.checkText). The empty state is not hostile — it explains itself and names its path. P-17: the frozen limits render at the point of use.

producerExamples.why: this pool's APY is SAMPLE — a fallback shape, NOT a value in the record (no live capture yet).
producerExamples.whatWouldMakeItJudgeable: run `./organon.sh capture` (keyless) to fetch and record a REAL, point-in-time reading; SAMPLE becomes REAL the moment it is in the moat.

producerExamples.why: not enough recorded history to show a reliable band for this pool's APY (12 observation(s) recorded).
producerExamples.whatWouldMakeItJudgeable: the band appears once enough point-in-time observations are captured (about 30 are needed) — capture on the cadence and it fills in.

producerExamples.why: the track record is too short or too autocorrelated to certify at 95% (12 observation(s)) — INSUFFICIENT is the honest name for "not enough evidence yet," never a failure.
producerExamples.whatWouldMakeItJudgeable: INSUFFICIENT clears to GO when the observed length exceeds MinTRL AND PSR(N_eff) > 0.95 (the literature's bar) — about 30 more observation(s); a real edge, recorded long enough, clears it.

producerExamples.why: this pool's APY cannot be resolved to a terminal answer (fewer than two positions) — UNJUDGEABLE is never silently treated as "independent" or "zero."
producerExamples.whatWouldMakeItJudgeable: add a second resolved position to the manifest — a shared-dependency count needs at least two to compare.

limitsAtPointOfUse.whyBounded: the staleness bound is verified only for these feeds; outside the subset the axis is UNJUDGEABLE by design, not silently degraded — the door says so before you rely on it.

limitsAtPointOfUse.resolvesFor: a demonstrated family of 2 (the manifest pair, D-family)
limitsAtPointOfUse.whyBounded: selection rank is demonstrated at family scale; a single-position family renders UNJUDGEABLE (a rank needs a field), stated at the point of use, not only in the log.

summary: 26 verdict words in the visible empty-state render, 0 bare (each must carry why + path); limits at point of use: oracle-staleness, selectionRank
